symbols.name: half-angle root of unity
symbols.meaning: The complex number $e^{\pi i/q}$, whose square is the root of unity $\omega$.
symbols.quote: Let $w = e^{\pi i/q}$ be the number whose square is $\omega$, so that $w^2 = \omega$.

symbols.name: reduced index
symbols.meaning: The index $(k-j) \bmod q$ in $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$ at which the chirp sequence $b$ is evaluated.
symbols.quote: Define $b_t = w^{-t^2}$ for $t \in \{0,\ldots,q-1\}$, where $t$ is the reduced index $(k-j) \bmod q$.

relations.quote: Bluestein's chirp identity rewrites a [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) so that it can be computed with convolution.
It computes its transforms by a [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) multiplied by chirp factors.
